Messages.Author: Thomas Stellmach
Messages.Body:
More questions:

Do retainers strike in an immortal grappled combat ?

Can all hand strikes be made by an immortal grappled vampire or only
the innate damage (ex. torn signpost) be inflicted ?

Thanks, Thomas

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Thomas Stellmach wrote:
>
> More questions:
>
> Do retainers strike in an immortal grappled combat ?

Not exactly. Retainers don't strike, ever. Retainers
that deal damage (Wolf Companion, Ghoul Retainer, etc.)
will do their thing even if their employer has been
grappled or has grappled someone else.

> Can all hand strikes be made by an immortal grappled vampire or only
> the innate damage (ex. torn signpost) be inflicted ?

Any hand strike can be made. Lucky Blow, Burning Wrath, etc.
